scope: Windows x64 pre-release for outside testers, with the recorded evidence and disclosed support limits
application_source: this repository's source at commit aef2d28; later commits change documents only, and the v0.6.0 tag names the final release-records commit
changes_since_previous_acceptance: 0.6.0: pixel art tools, frame-by-frame animation with layers as frames, Slate, Float and Atelier workspace styles with dockable palettes (preview; Classic stays the default), first-time setup, a Settings sidebar with search, Layer > Merge, timelapse length and sharp pixel art timelapses, and a lighter pen quick menu. The code is split into three crates. Evidence: local Verify Full, both packaging gates and a packaged startup; hosted Windows and Linux CI on the records commit before the tag. See RELEASE_DECISION.md. Previous accepted 0.5.0 binaries: dudel.exe 9671660F...D3D23589, dudel_thumbnails.dll C36C876C...F4A15F51.
